item.title: SUP Yoga on the Petaluma River — Fri Sep 18, 5:30 PM — The Floathouse Petaluma
item.description: This is SUP Yoga the Petaluma way—right downtown, deeply local, and rooted in our river. SUP Yoga at The Floathouse Petaluma invites locals to slow down and experience the Petaluma River as part of everyday life. Though we launch from the heart of downtown, the central turning basin holds a special calm. Once you’re on the water, the noise drops away and the river becomes what many of us love most about Petaluma: peaceful, welcoming, and shared. Sessions are gentle and all-levels, designed for neighbors as much as newcomers. We begin with a short, easy paddle from the docks to get comfortable on your board (knees are always welcome), then anchor together so tidal movement won’t interrupt your flow. From there, you’re free to move, stretch, breathe, rest—or simply float—guided by expert instruction and supported by community. item.title: 25th Anniversary Lake County Wine Auction — Sat Sep 19, 4:30 PM — Konocti Harbor Resort
item.description:
The Lake County Wine Auction raises a glass to 25 years on September 19, 2026, with a dazzling anniversary celebration at Konocti Harbor Resort in Kelseyville. This unforgettable evening will showcase exceptional Lake County wines, inspired cuisine, and one-of-a-kind auction lots you won’t find anywhere else.
For a quarter century, the Auction has poured generosity back into the community—donating more than $3 million to local nonprofits and all five Lake County high schools. Come celebrate the impact, the people, and the passion behind it all at a black-tie–encouraged night of glamour, gratitude, and great wine.

item.title: Culinary Garden Cooking Classes at Quivira Vineyards — Sun Sep 20, 12:00 AM — Quivira Vineyards and Winery
item.description:
Join an immersive, hands-on culinary series at Quivira Vineyards, offered June 7-November 15 from 11 AM - 2 PM. Led by Estate Chef Julia, guests begin in the organic estate garden harvesting seasonal ingredients before moving to the open-air kitchen to prepare a garden-inspired, multi-course meal. This interactive experience highlights the connection between garden, vineyard, and kitchen, while teaching practical culinary techniques. The evening concludes with a shared meal paired with Quivira wines in a beautiful estate setting. Each date features a different focus, including handmade pasta, masa and tacos, stuffed pasta, global dumplings, and seasonal pie baking. Space is limited for these unique seasonal classes.

item.title: The Harvest Kitchen: Fall Herbal Cooking Workshop with Sarah Kate Benjamin — Thu Sep 24, 9:00 AM
item.description:
Join Sarah Kate Benjamin of The Kosmic Kitchen for a fall herbal cooking workshop, and a day full of seasonal connection, nourishment, and restoration at the beautiful Osmosis Day Spa.
As the seasons turn inward, we’ll gather around the wisdom of the fall harvest, exploring herbal recipes and foods that nourish the body, ground the spirit, and invite deeper connection with the natural world. Through a hands-on herbal cooking class, we’ll prepare a seasonal meal together while discovering simple and joyful ways to weave plant medicine into everyday kitchen rituals, all while enjoying the peaceful sounds of the creek and the beauty of the surrounding gardens.
Following the cooking experience, you’ll spend the afternoon in deep relaxation, including a group cedar enzyme footbath, your choice of a 70-minute massage or 65-minute custom facial, a peaceful walking meditation through the bamboo forest, and a guided meditation in Osmosis’s renowned Japanese garden.

item.title: Intro to Stained Glass — Fri Sep 25, 5:15 PM — Art Escape Sonoma
item.description:
Looking for something different to do in Sonoma? Join us for a fun, hands-on introduction to stained glass!
In this beginner-friendly workshop, you'll learn the basics of the copper foil method, including how to apply copper foil, solder, clean, and finish your very own stained glass sun catcher.
All glass is pre-cut, ground, and ready for you to jump right into copper foiling and soldering. All materials and tools are provided. Finished pieces will be ready to take home at the end of class.
Please note: Please select your design when registering for the class. Due to the preparation required for each project, design changes cannot be made within 48 hours of the class. Glass colors may vary slightly from the photos, making every piece uniquely yours.
Important Health & Safety Information
This class involves the use of lead solder. Because there is no known safe level of lead exposure during pregnancy, this class is not recommended for anyone who is pregnant.

item.title: RIVER + REDWOODS FILM FESTIVAL — Fri Sep 25, 6:30 PM — Monte Rio Theater and Extravaganza
item.description:
**Join us for the River & Redwoods Film Festival (RRFF), September 25-27, at the historic Monte Rio Theater. The Festival is a 3 day celebration of independent films, networking, community, and Russian River fun!**
**THE PROGRAM SHOWCASES THE BEST OF BAY AREA CINEMA**
RRFF will showcase narrative features, documentaries, shorts, student work, and emerging voices from the Bay Area and beyond. This year’s Festival lineup includes more than 20 films that reflect the creativity and range of the North Bay and Bay Area, with filmmakers and artists represented from Monte Rio, Occidental, Forestville, Santa Rosa, Sebastopol, Sea Ranch, San Francisco, Oakland, and beyond.
Many of our films have recently screened at prestigious festivals including Tribeca Film Festival, SF International Film Festival, FRAMELINE LGBTQ+ Film Festival and many more.

item.description:

Nothing is quite as it seems—and yet everything is. Jeremy O.
